name: @red-cup-engineering/wheatstone
description: wheatstone — a MUD CLIENT, over @red-cup-engineering/arnold's diffed cell buffer. Named for Charles Wheatstone, telegraph pioneer. It speaks the telnet CLIENT side (IAC option negotiation; GMCP / MSDP / MXP handling, COMPRESS2 explicitly refused) via a small local wire-alphabet shim (no @561-group/tab dependency — see README), and renders a scrolling ANSI-colored world pane, a GMCP/MSDP-fed status line, an optional side panel (who/room/audit), and a command line (history, aliases, triggers, local slash-commands). The WORLD/CARRIER is PLUGGABLE: a world is {connect, send, onLine, onGMCP, close}; telnet is one carrier, farstone-world.mjs's REST/JSON carrier (against the live farstone.561.group MUD, no telnet involved) is another, proving the pluggability for real. THE LAW where it surfaces world state: CALM by default with audit-on-demand (the side panel's audit view), never flaunting the contradiction.
